newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT sets div for select preferred shares.
newsitem.headline: PLDT sets div for select preferred shares.

text.p: Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co (PLDT) has set a 50 centavo cash dividend to holders of its preferred shares series A, I and R, the Philippine Stock Exchange said on Tuesday.
The record date has been set on January 31, while the payment date is on February 28.
Holders of series W were also eligible to a 0.27 centavo cash dividend per day from the date of issue up to January 31. Series W shares were issued last year.
The same record and payment dates were set for holders of series W.
